_comment: Stored prompts. mode: 'edit' keeps the photo and applies an instruction (FLUX.2 only); 'restyle' re-draws it as img2img using strength (0.1 subtle → 1.0 ignore photo). Omit 'model' to use the selected/default model, or give a name (or part of one) to pin the preset to a model. Delete this whole list to have only Custom.

presets.label: Business suit
presets.prompt: Dress him in a well-tailored navy business suit with a white shirt and dark tie. Keep his face, hair, expression, pose and the background exactly the same.

presets.label: Headshot backdrop
presets.prompt: Replace the background with a clean, softly lit neutral grey studio backdrop, like a professional corporate headshot. Keep the person exactly the same.

presets.label: Clean up
presets.prompt: Remove distracting objects and clutter from the background, fix the lighting so the subject is evenly lit, and sharpen the image. Do not change the person.
